metadata.title: Capgo Alternatives – An Honest Comparison
metadata.description: Compare Capacitor live updates with Appflow, Expo EAS, and CodePush. OTA, rollback, channels, CI/CD, and migration paths in one place.

blocks.text: Capgo alternatives: honest comparisons for Capacitor teams
Side-by-side comparisons with Ionic Appflow, Capawesome, Microsoft CodePush, Expo EAS, Median, and VoltBuilder. Every competitor fact links to the vendor page it came from.
14-day unlimited free trial. No credit card required.
Each page has a side-by-side table, an honest section on when the other tool is the better pick, and a migration path.
Capgo covers what Appflow teams use most, live updates with channels and rollback plus cloud native builds, and keeps running after 2027. Migration swaps one plugin and your upload step.

props.aria-label: Read the Capgo vs Ionic Appflow comparison

blocks.text: Pick Capawesome for the lowest entry price and git-driven builds. Pick Capgo for a backend you can read and self-host, free MPL-2.0 plugins, and production scale since 2021.

props.aria-label: Read the Capgo vs Capawesome Cloud comparison

blocks.text: Capacitor, Ionic, or Cordova app: move to Capgo for hosted live updates with channels and rollback. React Native app: Capgo is not the fit; use EAS Update or self-host the archived server.

props.aria-label: Read the Capgo vs Microsoft CodePush comparison

blocks.text: Choose EAS when the product is React Native. Choose Capgo when the product is a web app and the goal is iOS and Android without rewriting the UI.

props.aria-label: Read the Capgo vs Expo Application Services comparison

blocks.text: Choose Median if you want to outsource the mobile shell and accept platform dependency. Choose Capgo with Capacitor if you want web-to-mobile delivery without giving up ownership or exit options.

props.aria-label: Read the Capgo vs Median comparison

blocks.text: Choose VoltBuilder if you only need store builds. Choose Capgo if you want native builds plus live updates, channels, and rollback after release.

What Capgo is not good at

Unlike Appflow's bundled approach, we give you flexibility. Use our Cloud Build for native iOS/Android builds, or integrate with your own CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc). Your choice - both work great.

Basic automatic updates are well documented. But Capgo has many options (manual, half-manual, channel_default, etc.) that aren't always easy to understand for every use case yet. We're actively improving this.

blocks.text: The Capgo Capacitor Updater plugin completely transformed how we ship updates. What used to take days now takes just minutes.
Being able to push production OTA updates instantly without waiting for full App Store review cycles has been a massive operational advantage.
Getting set up took less than a day. Channel-based rollouts let me test on my own device before anything hits production users.
